title: JAM: Controllable and Responsible Text Generation via Causal Reasoning and Latent Vector Manipulation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the average toxicity of model-generated text continuations using the RealToxicityPrompts dataset, measured automatically via the Detoxify tool.

Assessing the model's ability to generate harmless responses based on the HH-RLHF dataset, evaluated using automated metrics (Rouge2, Bleurt, Perplexity) and human-like preference judgments via GPT-4.
